summary.text: Dean Arp is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 69 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists his occupation as engineer and his county as Union.

paragraphs.text: Arp assumed office in the North Carolina House in 2013 and is in his seventh House term, according to the General Assembly's website.

In the 2025-2026 session he is senior chair of the Appropriations Committee, chair of the Energy and Public Utilities Committee and vice chair of the Appropriations, Capital and Information Technology Committee.
He also serves as co-chair of the Joint Legislative Commission on Energy Policy and the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Capital Improvements.
